answer: An hostile operator running 115 aliases therefore needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in ridge, and tundra lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 102 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
